text:
We don't like touchscreen voting machines for all voters either - but it's simply not true that they only switch votes one way. There were a lot of reports of votes being switched from Dem Beto O'Rourke to Rep Ted Cruz in TX in 2018. I don't agree that it's always innocent - but it's hard to know when a glitch is due to miscalibration or aging equipment and when it might be due to malware. Better to have as many voters as possible vote with hand-marked paper ballots and reserve touchscreens for voters who really want to use them, or need to due to a disability.
